senses.definition: Distinguished by a unique, particular, or unusual quality.
examples: a special episode of a television series
her special blend of spices

quotes.text:
EVERY CHILD IS SPECIAL
An empty and meaningless sentiment. What about every adult? Isn't every adult special? And if not, then at what age does a person go from being special to being not-so-special? And if every adult is also special, then that means all people are special and the idea has no meaning.
quotes.reference: 2004, George Carlin, “PLEASE DON'T SAY THAT”, in When Will Jesus Bring the Pork Chops?, New York: Hyperion Books, →ISBN, →OCLC, →OL, page 132:

senses.definition: Of particular value or interest; dear; beloved.
examples: Everyone is special to someone.
his special friend of many years, Bill

senses.definition: (military) Of or related to unconventional warfare.
examples: special forces, special operations

senses.definition: (law) Appointed specifically to examine a single event or issue.
examples: For the few times the U.S. Supreme Court has to actually try a case, they will appoint a special master to do so.
After the Watergate break in, a special prosecutor was appointed.

senses.definition: Constituting or relating to a species.
examples: Having seven dark spots is a special property unique to Coccinella septempunctata.

senses.definition: (euphemistic, not comparable) Of or related to disabilities, especially learning or intellectual disabilities.
examples: special education, special needs
He goes to a special school.

subsenses.definition: (by extension, derogatory, often offensive, comparable) Stupid, lacking intelligence.
examples: What do you mean, you don't understand the sign? What are you, special?

senses.definition: Of, being, or pertaining to sexual intercourse or the genitals.
examples: The parents told the kids not to bother them during special time.
The girl said the man had tried to touch her special place.

senses.definition: Infused with a drug, especially marijuana; being an edible.

senses.definition: A reduction in consumer cost (usually for a limited time) for items or services rendered; the thing thus sold.
examples: We're running a special on turkey for Thanksgiving.
I didn't have much money, so I bought the special.

senses.definition: A meal offered only at a certain time by a restaurant, not as a standing fixture of the menu; often, one of a rotation of meals systematically offered for a lower price; also often a dish at a nondiscounted price that is seasonal or otherwise exciting or unusual.
examples: Today's dinner special is wild salmon, which we don't normally get a chance to offer.
The Tuesday lunch special is our tuna melt on rye.

senses.definition: (broadcasting) Unusual or exceptional episode of a series.
examples: Did you see the Christmas special?

senses.definition: (British, colloquial) A special constable.

quotes.text: And you can't trust a "Special" like the old-time copper when you can't find your way home.

senses.definition: Anything that is not according to normal practice, plan, or schedule, as an unscheduled run of transportation that is normally scheduled.
examples: Thousands came to see the special that carried the President's coffin.

senses.definition: Any unlicensed medicine produced or obtained for a specific individual patient.
(pinball) An award, typically a free game, that is made available to the player upon reaching or completing a major objective in a pinball game.
(journalism) A journalist sent to the scene of an event to report back.
(journalism) A dispatch sent back by a special correspondent.
(theater) A light that illuminates a specific person or thing on the stage.

quotes.text: In addition to followspots, there will be three frontlight specials on Autoyokes hung on the truss to provide frontlight specials.

quotes.text: The first is a special—a single lighting instrument that lights a particular spot on the stage. Specials generally have no color, or a more saturated color, allowing them to stand out through other lighting onstage.

senses.definition: One of certain mixed-breed dogs.
examples: Singapore Special;  Darwin special
